source_name: ПОВ Портал (ovp.gov.mk) — обврска „Јавните набавки како отворени податоци“
why_relevant: Open Government Partnership national action-plan portal carrying the commitment to publish procurement as open data. Tells you what machine-readable publication is promised, by whom and by when — i.e. where the ESJN data pipeline is expected to improve, and who to press if it does not.

Training/test instance of the same platform. Useful for safely mapping the URL scheme, form parameters and service calls of the production portal without hammering production, and for detecting platform version changes.

source_name: Фонд за здравствено осигурување (ФЗО) and similar state funds — procurement document stores
why_relevant: Public-adjacent institutions that mirror Public Procurement Bureau documents and run their own payment-related IT procurement; useful as secondary copies of MoF/BJN documents and as additional buyer signals.

entity_name: LinkedIn member profiles / CVs of MK banking-IT staff
source_name: LinkedIn member profiles / CVs of MK banking-IT staff
why_relevant: Individual CVs state the platforms people ran inside named MK banks — e.g. a Skopje developer profile describing support for a migration to Oracle FLEXCUBE. This is the strongest per-bank vendor-attribution signal in the whole cell, though it is personal data.

entity_name: LinkedIn member profiles / CVs of MK banking-IT staff
source_name: Macedonian e-Commerce Association LinkedIn page (and event posts by MK banks/vendors)
why_relevant: LinkedIn is where MK banks, PSPs and ICT vendors post 'we sponsored / we spoke at' content, usually with photos of the sponsor wall and named executives — often the only public record of smaller events and of which bank staff attended.

entity_name: LinkedIn member profiles / CVs of MK banking-IT staff
source_name: Diners Club International Mak (Diners Club Macedonia) — issuer/acquirer of the DC franchise
why_relevant: Holder of the Diners Club franchise in MK (first credit card in the country, 1996; ~3,000 acceptance outlets), locally owned since the 2020 buy-out from Erste Card Club, and a CaSys processing client — a distinct three-party acquiring network beside the bank acquirers.

entity_name: LinkedIn member profiles / CVs of MK banking-IT staff
why_relevant: Skopje software firm (est. 1990) self-describing finance and insurance application experience; candidate supplier of niche bank back-office systems. Low-yield individually but part of the local vendor census this cell must enumerate.

source_name: STEP — Systematic Tracking of Exchanges in Procurement (World Bank)
why_relevant: The upstream system of record behind all WB procurement plans and contract-award data; understanding its fields and publication lag is necessary to interpret and time the Finances One dataset.

source_name: Duna (Duna Computers) — Macedonian integrator, ULTIMA product and corporate project references
why_relevant: Long-established MK integrator with corporate/enterprise project references and mobile/document-management solutions; a plausible sub-supplier or channel partner in bank projects, and a route to named local references.

source_name: Melon Solutions (Мелон Солушнс) — Skopje, e-banking / banking systems
why_relevant: Directory-confirmed Skopje supplier categorised under online banking, banking systems, e-business solutions and call centres — i.e. a local delivery partner in the private-bank channel. Not previously in the seed actor list; needs its own corporate domain resolved.

Long-running aggregator of World Bank, EU, UN and national donor solicitations with per-buyer indexes; a secondary net for MK donor-funded notices and a historical archive when primary portals rotate URLs.

source_name: EU Publications Office — Public procurement / TED, North Macedonia notices
why_relevant: IPA- and EU-funded procurements executed in North Macedonia (including e-government, payment and IT projects) are published here rather than only nationally. Structured, English-language, and machine-accessible — a complement to ESJN for donor-funded banking/payments IT.

source_name: Glassdoor — Skopje employer salary and openings pages
why_relevant: Employee-reported job titles and salaries per MK employer; title taxonomies ('Card Systems Administrator', 'Core Banking Developer') corroborate which platform teams exist inside a bank or vendor even when no ad is currently live.

source_name: Schmidt & Schmidt — North Macedonia commercial register extracts & financial statements (procurement intermediary)
why_relevant: Documents, in English, what document types the MK register actually issues (extracts, annual accountancy statements, pledges, leasing, ownership certificates) and provides a paid channel to obtain them from abroad without an MK account. Useful as a fallback when CRM's own payment/account flow is impractical.

Practitioner-facing site with manuals for economic operators on preparing bids in the ESJN. Useful for decoding portal workflow, field names and procedure types, which improves parsing accuracy; also a pointer to the consultant community that tracks tenders commercially.
